meta.title: Kubernetes: One Pod disappears. Who brings it back?

design.visualThesis: A missing replica becomes a visible gap that the reconciliation loop closes.
design.motionGrammar: Stable diagram positions, short eased entrances, single purposeful change per beat.
design.assetLanguage: Original SVG/HTML schematics. No screenshots or simulated terminal presented as live evidence.

scenes.purpose: One Pod disappears. Who brings it back?
scenes.narration: Delete one Pod. Who brings your app back? Here's Kubernetes in one minute.

phrases.en: Delete one Pod. Who brings your app back?

scenes.visual: Original animated schematic; illustrative, not a live cluster recording.

scenes.purpose: You declare it. Kubernetes maintains it.
scenes.narration: Imagine your web app needs three copies. Set three replicas in a Deployment. Each copy runs in a Pod, which contains your application container.

phrases.en: Imagine your web app needs three copies.
Set three replicas in a Deployment.
Each copy runs in a Pod, which contains your application container.

scenes.visual: Original animated schematic; illustrative, not a live cluster recording.

scenes.narration: Now one of those Pods is deleted. The ReplicaSet controller notices the gap: you want three, but only two remain.

phrases.en: Now one of those Pods is deleted.
The ReplicaSet controller notices the gap: you want three, but only two remain.

scenes.visual: Original animated schematic; illustrative, not a live cluster recording.

scenes.purpose: Notice the gap. Create a new Pod.
scenes.narration: It creates a replacement Pod. The scheduler picks a suitable node, and the kubelet starts its containers. That loop is called reconciliation.

phrases.en: The scheduler picks a suitable node, and the kubelet starts its containers.

scenes.visual: Original animated schematic; illustrative, not a live cluster recording.

scenes.narration: But clients need a stable address. A Service routes traffic to ready Pods. The replacement joins when it's ready.

phrases.en: But clients need a stable address.
A Service routes traffic to ready Pods.
The replacement joins when it's ready.

scenes.visual: Original animated schematic; illustrative, not a live cluster recording.

scenes.narration: Recovery takes time and available resources. Kubernetes won't fix broken application code.

phrases.en: Recovery takes time and available resources.
Kubernetes won't fix broken application code.

scenes.visual: Original animated schematic; illustrative, not a live cluster recording.

scenes.purpose: Declare the goal. Keep closing the gap.
scenes.narration: You declare the desired state. Kubernetes keeps working toward it. Try three replicas in a test cluster, then delete one Pod and watch.

phrases.en: You declare the desired state. Kubernetes keeps working toward it.
Try three replicas in a test cluster, then delete one Pod and watch.

scenes.visual: Original animated schematic; illustrative, not a live cluster recording.
